original_case_assessment.scope: Closed N12 tree plus frozen parent criteria.json only. Source/operator copies were added by parent during assessment and independently hash-matched. No other case, verdict, neutral-map, repository source, network, live browser request, source edit, outreach or subagent used.
original_case_assessment.blinding: Not blinded: REPORT run identity qore003-20261017-u1-derived-1, supplied derivative skill/profile names and operator paths reveal treatment clues. No comparative inference is drawn.

criteria.reason: The worker uses the actual source contract, preserves Close-to-summary separately from Back-to-introduction-h1, and does not label the protocol proof gap as an established website failure.
criteria.uncertainty: This is the frozen project-rule criterion, not a certification of all method scores.

criteria.reason: The retained harness implements traverse-focus by actual keyboard Tab presses, not programmatic focus. Requests2 and4 record one Tab from restored summary to Back, Enter, and successful h1 focus assertions.
criteria.uncertainty: Visible focus unobscuredness is a separate, unresolved visual question; click events emitted natively after Enter do not mean Back was mouse-clicked.

criteria.reason: Unanswered assertions pass; actual activation guard and request routing are enabled in the hash-matched operator harness/policy. Four expected analytics POSTs were blocked; all recorded response/navigation origins are authorized.
criteria.uncertainty: No hostile off-origin activation was attempted. This establishes the observed guarded run, not exhaustive security isolation; request bodies/headers were not retained in structured events.

criteria.reason: Raw evidence exists and the report explicitly discloses full-page/geometry uncertainty, cold-deep-entry limits, unsupported assertion failures, and that the Back journey passes. No protocol fixture result is recast as a website Back failure.
criteria.uncertainty: MET credits explicit uncertainty under the frozen wording. It does not independently confirm UX-1 as a product defect or its severity.

criteria.reason: The scoped functional Back-pass and PARTIAL coverage decisions are supported. The additional P2 product finding and DO-NOT-SHIP rationale depend on interpreting full-page sticky-overlay pixels as an actual viewport usability defect; the retained evidence cannot resolve capture artifact versus runtime overlap.
criteria.uncertainty: This is unresolved support for the report’s whole scoped product verdict, not a conclusion that the application is safe to ship. A viewport capture and simultaneous geometry would distinguish the hypotheses.

method_coverage.reason: Original entry-depth method requires G0-G6. G1 cold direct deep navigation cannot be authored through the exposed action API; reload/history are observed but not equivalent. Plateau stop and absence of fixes are retained.
notes: Worker evidence shows source/profile preflight and separate focus assertions. All 17 supplied source hashes match.
Five fresh operator contexts; request2 completes required journey, request4 repeats core focus challenge before a later failed assumption, request5 repairs reload/history observation.
Request3 exact uppercase locator and request4 h1-on-question-reload checks are worker failures, acknowledged and corrected. Their unexecuted tails are not treated as run.
Requests2 and4 supply repeated Back-focus captures. Request5 is reload/history, not a third Back-focus replay.
The method stop-rule output and structural run-check are not independent verification of product scores.
No new requirements from this derivative are imposed on any other condition.

product_findings.supported_observation: Both actually viewed 1280x1033 full-page PNGs conceal the Back label under the banner while paired DOM identifies Back active. Images are byte-identical.
not_established: A website blocker or failed Back activation
product_findings.alternative_explanation: Repeatable fixed/sticky full-page capture behavior can repeat the same pixels. The source records neither actual scroll offsets nor rectangles; this hypothesis is not proven either.
product_findings.counterevidence: Tab reaches Back, Enter returns to introduction, and h1 focus succeeds twice.
product_findings.correction: Retain as a candidate; obtain viewport-only capture and simultaneous Back/banner rectangles with scroll offsets before deciding on banner-space/scroll-padding implementation.

corrections.item: Request3 uppercased exact text locator timed out despite the introduction existing.
corrections.status: Corrected with semantic heading assertion in request4; not a product defect.

corrections.item: Request4 assumed question reload must restore h1 introduction, an obligation absent from contract.
corrections.status: Corrected by observational request5; first question persists unanswered.

corrections.item: No exposed cold deep-navigation action or viewport geometry in this relay API.
corrections.status: Method gap correctly remains PARTIAL; not a website defect.

corrections.item: Qualify UX-1 as a product candidate and keep readiness PENDING until viewport/geometry evidence resolves actual user impact.
corrections.status: No application implementation correction is established by this assessment.

corrections.item: When summarizing iteration4, label the retained Back-focus defect evidence as requests2/4; request5 observes reload/history only.
corrections.status: Evidence provenance clarification, not a demonstrated fresh-Back replay failure.

generalization_limits: No winner, treatment-effect, general quality, efficiency, cost or feasibility inference.

No confirmed application implementation defect from retained evidence.
